title: Federate the yaml-lsp plugin into opum-marketplace as a pinned entry (DEC-87 B)
description: DEC-87 (operator, read from opum-agent origin/dev .quest/planning.json on 2026-09-30): yaml-lsp gets its own new PUBLIC repository, created first-party by the operator (opum-agent OPAG-960), and opum-marketplace lists it federated like the other five entries; this repository owns no plugin content directly and its checks and prose are unchanged. This task was re-scoped from the DEC-85 A in-repo build to the federation entry. Scope once unblocked: a github-source entry pinned to a release tag of opum-ai/yaml-lsp, the fresh skills/ subtree baseline in scripts/federated-pin-baselines.json in the same change, the regenerated Codex mirror, all local gates, and the PR into dev. Blocked on OPAG-960: the repository and its first release tag must exist before the entry can be pinned and verified live. Measurements that still apply to the new repository's plugin are kept in this task's notes.

acceptanceCriteria.text: marketplace.json lists yaml-lsp as a federated github entry pinned to a release tag of opum-ai/yaml-lsp whose own plugin.json declares that version, verified live by check · manifests and the federated pin checker.
scripts/federated-pin-baselines.json records the skills/ subtree SHA resolved fresh at that tag, in the same change as the pin, and the content checker resolves and matches it.
generate-codex-marketplace --check exits 0 with the Codex mirror carrying yaml-lsp, and a Codex install of the pinned entry succeeds from a clean isolated CODEX_HOME.
The local gates pass (the five test suites, lore check and lore agents --check) and the PR into dev carries the three required contexts completed green on its head SHA.

(2) Glob mapping from DEC-85 A: yaml-language-server --stdio for .yaml and .yml, both mapping to languageId yaml. (3) Codex: codex-cli 0.159.2 parses and INSTALLS a string source ./plugins/x from a local marketplace (normalized to a local source, plugin.json name cross-checked); the git-marketplace case is unverified. (4) As federated host: the pin checker requires <repo>/<ref>/.claude-plugin/plugin.json to declare the pinned version, and the content checker requires the skills/ subtree SHA in scripts/federated-pin-baselines.json in the same change, so the new repository carries its own manifest with the lspServers config; whether lspServers can also ride inline on a github-source entry here is unmeasured.
